West's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited sessions for WR Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring), S Siran Neal (knee, foot), and CB Upton Stout (shoulder, neck). The defensive lineman appears likely to miss action moving forward, and if that is the case, rookie James Thompson could stand to see an increase in opportunities behind starting defensive tackles Osa Odighizuwa and DeForest Buckner.

rawStream.title: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Halton sustained a broken left ankle in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 38-17 win over Las Vegas and will require season-ending surgery.
rawStream.summary: Though the rookie defensive tackle had been expected to move into more of a rotational role following the 49ers' recent acquisition of DeForest Buckner, the loss of Halton still represents a major hit to the team's line depth. Halton will finish up his inaugural campaign with 15 tackles (nine solo), two sacks, one pass defensed, one forced fumble, one fumble recovery and one touchdown in eight games.
